market_view: VIX 15 and falling, but the 30-year yield is at a 19-year high (5.33%) and the 10-year is 4.72%, near its high: a headwind for gold miners and long-duration stocks. Oil is re-escalating on the Iran ceasefire expiry.

oil_gas.catalyst: "Oil prices jump after US-Iran ceasefire expires and Trump threatens Oman" (The Guardian, 2026-08-18): a supply shock to crude that is still escalating; XOM (+1.05% in 5 days) has lagged WTI and Brent.
oil_gas.reasoning: Continue the XOM long from 2026-08-10. The ceasefire has expired and the Hormuz risk is rising, so crude is still moving, and XOM has only partly followed it. Exit on a deal. Shale spending cuts also support prices.

gold_miners.reasoning: NEM is up 35% in 20 days and the move is priced. The 10-year and 30-year yields are at highs, and gold is below its 200-day average. The headlines hold nothing unpriced: a museum grant and an FT letter on central-bank gold.

chips.reasoning: A BigGo headline says the Philadelphia semiconductor index plunged over 6%, but the record shows the sector ETF up 1.06% on 2026-08-17, so it is unverifiable or stale, and in a high-volatility regime I will not guess a rebound. The Nvidia financing items are not an unpriced stock catalyst.

pharma.catalyst: Lilly Q2 guidance raise on 2026-08-05 (from the handoff note); no negative headline since, and the one pharma headline is unrelated (California insurance race).
pharma.reasoning: Hold LLY to the planned exit near 2026-08-19, about one more day of the original 10-day window. LLY pulled back 4% in 5 days with no negative news, which is not a reason to exit. A short remaining horizon limits the added cost.

copper_uranium.reasoning: The Walz order against copper mining near the Boundary Waters is a local project issue (the title names no FCX asset) and does not move global supply. The Congo panic has faded and FCX is up 16% in 20 days. No confirmed unpriced catalyst.

would_change_my_mind: A US-Iran deal or a reopened Hormuz (exit XOM); a negative LLY headline (exit); a named unpriced catalyst in gold, chips or copper (go long).

handoff.what_changed: The US-Iran ceasefire expired and oil jumped (WTI 84.5, Brent 90.87), so the XOM long is kept. The 30-year yield hit a 19-year high of 5.33%. An unverified headline says the semiconductor index plunged over 6%, while the record shows the ETF up 1.06% on 2026-08-17. Copper news is limited to a Minnesota order against mining near the Boundary Waters.

gold_miners.why: NEM is up 35% in 20 days, the move is priced, and yields are at highs with gold below its 200-day average.

chips.why: No named catalyst; the plunge headline is unverified against the record and the sector is volatile.

pharma.why: Guidance raise on 2026-08-05 with no negative news; exit around 2026-08-19.

copper_uranium.why: The Congo panic faded, and the Boundary Waters order is a local project matter with no FCX-specific effect.
